text:
Proposal of the Fig


I propose to you

the sweetness of the fig,

its rosy flesh,

folded and

moist

like a sea animal.


Enjoy the mystery of this fruit,

its mollusk texture,

its intimate

size.

Smooth,

its pulp

will press the desire

of your tongue.


I propose to you

the delights of the fig.

Bite its violated,

forsaken center,

taste again—stubborn—

its flesh

that

keeps honeys and deluges.


The delights and sweetness of the fig

—small and overflowing—

only this I

propose to you.

Let your deep mouth

linger

in the secret sweetness,

let it slowly assault

its unveiled flesh.


Let it bring to your palate

the memory

of primitive flavors.

translation.title: To Your Broad Jade Body
translation.editorial_note: This alternate-title variant preserves the embedded Fig Proposal heading and duplicate source body.
